name: Over-Door / Film Attack
description: Camera film or a thin loop of material inserted over the top of a door and into the frame gap can be used to manipulate levers, thumb turns, or latches on the interior side. The technique is effective on outward-opening doors where interior hardware is accessible through the door gap. RTT's camera film is specifically designed for this application and is one of the most covert bypass tools available — there is no audible indication of the attack and it leaves no visible marks.

blue.det: Time at door; film loop visible above door if observed from inside; door open alert.
blue.cm: Door top seals reducing gap; door alarms; camera coverage of door from inside showing top of frame; door frame reinforcement.
